import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path


def render_slot(slot):
    return f"{slot['id']}\t{slot['title']}\t{slot['room']}"


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Print a calendar batch")
    parser.add_argument("input", type=Path, nargs="?", default=Path(__file__).with_name("slots.json"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    slots = json.loads(args.input.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for slot in slots:
        print(render_slot(slot))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
